decisions.reason: The candidate already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording the First Mint replacement with First Referral and the related icon presentation decisions; no additional change is required.
Replacing a badge with a First Referral badge does not change ticket allocation for mints without referral codes.
The badge awarded for a first referral does not alter referral-based prize-ticket issuance, recipients, quantities, or ticket cycles.
The badge catalog change does not modify the Big Block prize amount, winners, trigger, eligibility, or reset rules.
The existing requirement that permanent badges remain visible in NFT metadata is unchanged; badge identity and presentation are already owned by the badge-catalog requirement.
Introducing a First Referral badge does not change the referral commission amount or automatic payout mode.
The badge replacement does not change either Small Block or Big Block ticket-counter accounting.
The badge catalog decision does not modify the Small Block prize, draw trigger, ticket window, or reset behavior.
The First Referral badge decision does not affect random winner selection, eligible populations, ticket weighting, or applicable draws.
The badge design and trigger change does not alter the network deployment requirement.
The badge replacement does not change the manual prize-claim and delivery flow.
The badge catalog decision does not affect enforcement of royalties on secondary sales.
